text:
rita: planning to enable meridian-14b-quant in catalog in tonight's 23:00-01:00 UTC window. Need quick alignment on fallback precedence, regional priming, and a short pin window.

deploy-bot: scheduled by @rita for 3525004800. Canary plan: 2% for 12m -> 10% for 25m. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 1.7% or p95 latency > 1.5s.

hao: runtime fallback suggestion:
fallbacks: [meridian-14b-quant, meridian-14b, meridian-14b-legacy]
priming: canary_nodes_only
eu_priming: manual_after_na
fallback_hold_minutes: 12
This keeps quant preferred and prevents rapid flapping.

margo: agree with canary-only warmup. Request a 90 minute pin-lock so we can revert to meridian-14b:20260228 if we need to. Also add telemetry hooks for fallback_rate and mem_evictions.

sre-oncall: we'll monitor metrics. If mem_evictions spike or host OOM events appear we'll request an immediate drain. Oncall will post go/no-go within first canary tranche.

r: final checklist: (1) deploy-bot schedule locked, (2) priming=canary_nodes_only, (3) eu_priming=manual_after_na, (4) fallback order as above, (5) pin_lock=90m, (6) alerts wired (p95 heatmap, fallback_rate, mem_evictions). Anyone object?

hao: adding small debounce to avoid oscillation after fallback: 12 minutes hold. config snippet for release-bot: {"model":"meridian-14b-quant","canary_pct":2,"canary_minutes":12,"ramp_pct":10,"pin_lock_minutes":90,"priming":"canary_nodes_only","eu_priming":"manual_after_na","fallback_hold_minutes":12}.

margo: I'll update release notes to call out EU warmup deferral and pin-lock.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed. Ready to start at scheduled time unless aborted.

rita: thanks, kicking off at 3525004800. Ping here immediately for rollback requests. :rocket:
